title: Headless I Fought the Law (VMS02), the fail: Eddie's first job (stage 10), Eddie killed before the job is done (110)

actions.text: Path, the fail: Eddie's first job (stage 10, as in i-fought-the-law); then the player kills Eddie while not allied with the NCR (kill stands in for the fight; NCRCFEddieDeathScript sets stage 110 and stops the quest). Travel is move_player.
